text: No tree-cover loss was detected on this property after 2020. The evidence shows that between 2021 and 2025, no loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger occurred within the asset’s boundary. The JRC 2020 forest map confirms the entire asset was non-forested (0 ha) as of 2020, while the Hansen dataset shows only 0.4 ha of tree cover existed in 2000. Observations were valid across the full property. However, smaller changes (under 0.5 ha) or those narrower than the 30-meter pixel resolution may not be detectable. The data supports no clear-cutting or large-scale deforestation post-2020, but it doesn’t rule out minor, localized tree removal.
